source: engine/vocab.py (generated by python -m engine.export_spec; do not edit)

sector.q: Which sector is the project in?

technology.q: What technology does the project use?

state.q: Which Indian state is the project in?

capacity_mw.q: What is the installed capacity in MW?

start_date.q: When did (or will) the project start construction or operation? (YYYY-MM)

carbon_considered_pre_investment.q: Was carbon revenue considered before the investment decision, with written evidence (board note, loan file)?

grid_connected.q: Is the project connected to the electricity grid?

baseline.q: What does the project replace, or what would have happened without it?

receives_recs.q: Does the project receive Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) or other environmental attributes for the same output?

land_ownership.q: Who owns the land, or holds rights over it?

ccts_obligated.q: Is the project owner an obligated entity under India's Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (a notified emissions-intensity target)?

target_buyer.q: Who do you expect to sell credits to?

scale.q: Roughly how big are the expected reductions? (small = under 60,000 t CO2e a year)

annual_mwh.q: Expected net electricity supplied per year (MWh)?

has_storage.q: Does the project include battery or other energy storage?

annual_waste_tpy.q: How many tonnes of waste does the landfill receive per year?

landfill_opening_year.q: In what year did the landfill open?

landfill_closure_year.q: In what year will (or did) the landfill close?

climate_zone.q: Is the site's climate wet tropical or dry tropical?

lfg_end_use.q: What will the captured landfill gas be used for?

animal_type.q: Which animals does the manure come from?

manure_baseline_system.q: How is the manure handled today, before the project?

biogas_end_use.q: How will the biogas be used?

farm_scale.q: Is this a household unit, a small farm, a large farm or a centralised plant?

productivity.q: Is this a typical Indian farm (low) or a high-yield commercial dairy (high)?

species_group.q: What is the main tree type?

zone.q: Which climate zone is the site in?

is_mangrove.q: Is this a mangrove planting or restoration?

is_wetland.q: Is any of the land a wetland?

forest_cleared_10y.q: Was any natural forest cleared on this land in the last 10 years?

ee_mode.q: Is this an efficiency upgrade, a fuel switch, or both?

fuel_from.q: Which fuel are you switching from?

fuel_to.q: Which fuel are you switching to?

fuel_ncv.q: Net calorific value of the fuel (GJ/t), if known?

legally_required.q: Is the project required by any law, regulation, court order or permit condition?

project_activity_type.q: Is this a new plant, an addition to an existing plant, or an upgrade/rehabilitation/replacement of existing equipment?

hydro_reservoir.q: (Hydro only) Which describes the reservoir? 'pd' = installed watts per m2 of reservoir surface.

supplies_end_consumer.q: Will the power be sold directly to a specific consumer (open access, captive or corporate PPA) rather than into the grid?

on_agri_or_forest_land.q: Is any of the plant built on land officially classed as agricultural or forest land?

new_equipment.q: Is all the main equipment (panels, turbines, generators) new and never used before?

lfg_already_used.q: Before the project, was any captured landfill gas already used for energy (not just flared or vented)?

swds_management_change.q: Will you change how the landfill is run (e.g. add liquids, recirculate leachate) to make more gas?

reduces_organic_recycling.q: Would the project reduce organic waste that would otherwise be composted or recycled?

livestock_confined.q: Are the animals kept in sheds or pens (not grazing freely) so manure can be collected?

manure_to_water.q: Is manure or digester slurry discharged into a river, lake, pond or canal?

manure_retention_months.q: Today, how many months does manure stay in the lagoon or pit before it is removed?

baseline_methane_recovery.q: Is any biogas already captured and burnt or used at the site today?

co_digestion.q: Will the digester also take other organic waste (crop residue, food waste) besides manure?

soil_disturbance_pct.q: What share of the area (%) will be ploughed, dug or trenched for planting? (pits 0.5 m x 0.5 m at 3 m spacing = about 3%)

mangrove_share_pct.q: What share of the planted area (%) will be mangrove species?

alters_hydrology.q: Will the project change water flows (bunds, channels, drainage) on the site or connected wetlands?

nitrogen_fertilizer.q: Will chemical fertilizer or manure be applied in the project area?

energy_metered.q: Can the energy use of the equipment be measured directly (meters, fuel records, steam flow)?

maintenance_only.q: Are the savings only from better maintenance (cleaning filters, fixing leaks), with no new equipment?

same_output.q: Will the plant make the same products, at the same or better quality, as before?

thermal_capacity_mwth.q: Total rated heat output of the new equipment (MW thermal)?

biomass_source.q: If the project burns biomass, where does it come from (crop residue, forest residue, a dedicated plantation)?

existing_plant_5y.q: (Existing plants only) Has the existing plant run commercially for at least 5 years, with no expansion or retrofit in that time?

bess_same_site.q: (With storage) Is the battery on the same site as the plant, directly connected, sharing one grid connection, with the same owner and investment decision?

heat_baseline_fossil.q: (If the gas will make heat) Would that heat otherwise come from burning fossil fuel (coal, oil, gas) in your own equipment?

site_above_5c.q: Is the site's average yearly temperature above 5 °C? (True almost everywhere in India except high-altitude Himalayan areas.)

lagoon_depth_1m.q: (If manure is kept in a lagoon today) Is each lagoon at least 1 metre deep?

lowers_water_table.q: Will the project lower the water table on the site (e.g. drain it)? Reconnecting tidal flow or converting open water does not count.

pre_project_use_displaced.q: Will any current use of the land (farming, grazing, aquaculture, fuelwood) have to move somewhere else because of the project?

thermal_capacity_increase.q: Will the switch increase the plant's heat output capacity or extend the equipment's life?
